title: Workers start through a launcher command the operator sets, and kbmon reads agent states from an external source through a JSON contract
goal: backlog.json takes launcher, an argv list in which {dir} stands for the worker's worktree and {command} for its command as one shell line, which dispatch runs in place of its own detached start, the current start staying the default; kbmon takes agent_states, a command whose JSON lines give a pid or a session id and a state (working, blocked, idle, done) and shows that state on the session's row of its sessions panel; both contracts are documented with no product named, so a terminal workspace manager or any other runtime can host the workers and report their states; backlog.py config prints both settings

run:
import json,os,re,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,time,pathlib as P
if os.name=="nt":
    print("check skipped: needs a POSIX host");sys.exit(0)
T=os.path.abspath("_tools");d=P.Path(os.path.realpath(tempfile.mkdtemp(dir="/tmp")));rem=d/"remote.git"
s.run(["git","init","-q","--bare","-b","main",str(rem)],check=True)
b=d/"bin";b.mkdir()
(b/"claude").write_text("#!/bin/sh\ncat >/dev/null\necho '{\"subtype\":\"success\",\"num_turns\":1,\"total_cost_usd\":0,\"session_id\":\"s1\",\"result\":\"done\"}'\n");os.chmod(b/"claude",0o755)
L=d/"launch.py";L.write_text("import json,os,subprocess,sys\nopen(os.environ['KB_LAUNCH_MARK'],'a').write(json.dumps(sys.argv[1:])+chr(10))\nsys.exit(subprocess.run(sys.argv[2],shell=True,cwd=sys.argv[1]).returncode)\n")
def run(name,launcher):
    r=d/name;s.run(["git","clone","-q",str(rem),str(r)],check=True,capture_output=True)
    g=lambda *a:s.run(["git","-C",str(r),*a],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
    cfg={"item_dir":"items","scratch_dir":"_cache/scratch","worktree_dir":"wt","forge":"","land_push":["git","push","origin","HEAD:"+name]}
    if launcher:cfg["launcher"]=[sys.executable,str(L),"{dir}","{command}"]
    (r/"backlog.json").write_text(json.dumps(cfg));(r/"items").mkdir();(r/".gitignore").write_text("_cache/\nwt/\n");(r/"x.txt").write_text("x")
    (r/"items"/"SP-zzlaunsp.json").write_text(json.dumps({"id":"SP-zzlaunsp","kind":"sprint","title":"s","status":"active","goal":"g"}))
    (r/"items"/"ST-zzlaunch.json").write_text(json.dumps(dict(id="ST-zzlaunch",kind="story",title="t",status="todo",priority="P3",goal="g",touches=["x.txt"],checks=[{"run":["python3","-c","pass"]}],sprint="SP-zzlaunsp"),indent=2)+"\n")
    g("add","-A");g("-c","user.name=x","-c","user.email=x@x","commit","-qm","i");g("push","-q","origin","HEAD:"+name)
    mark=d/(name+".mark")
    env=dict(os.environ,KB_COORD_STORE=str(d/"coord.sqlite"),CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA=str(d/(name+"-data")),CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=os.path.dirname(T),KB_LAUNCH_MARK=str(mark),CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID="chk",PATH=str(b)+os.pathsep+os.environ["PATH"],GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="x",GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="x@x",GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="x",GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="x@x")
    s.run([sys.executable,T+"/backlog.py","--root",str(r),"claim","ST-zzlaunch","--by","claude-chk"],capture_output=True,text=True,env=env,timeout=120)
    p=s.run([sys.executable,T+"/backlog.py","--root",str(r),"dispatch","ST-zzlaunch","--detach"],capture_output=True,text=True,env=env,timeout=300)
    res=r/"_cache"/"scratch"/"ST-zzlaunch"/"result.json"
    for _ in range(150):
        if res.exists() and res.stat().st_size:break
        time.sleep(0.2)
    m=[json.loads(x) for x in mark.read_text().splitlines()] if mark.exists() else []
    print(name,"dispatch exit",p.returncode,"result",res.exists(),"launcher calls",m,p.stdout[-300:],p.stderr[-300:])
    return p.returncode,res.exists(),m,r
c1,r1,m1,root1=run("with",True)
c0,r0,m0,_=run("default",False)
wt=str(root1/"wt")
used=c1==0 and r1 and len(m1)==1 and m1[0][0].startswith(wt) and "claude" in m1[0][1]
default=c0==0 and r0 and not m0
sys.exit(0 if used and default else 1)

import re,sys
def para(f,w):
    return [p for p in re.split(r'\n\s*\n',open(f).read()) if w in p]
a=para('kb/_self/backlog.md','{command}');b=para('kb/_self/monitoring.md','agent_states')
bad=[p for p in a+b if re.search(r'herdr|tmux|zellij|wezterm|iterm|kitty',p,re.I)]
print(len(a),len(b),len(bad));sys.exit(0 if a and b and not bad else 1)

import subprocess as s,sys;p=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/backlog.py','config'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60,check=True);print(p.stdout);sys.exit(0 if 'launcher' in p.stdout and 'agent_states' in p.stdout else 1)
